recover.how: beside 6737, pick one at the first look
recover.note: the stepped lane in the evening: lamps lit, the lane in shade below the sunlit yellow house. A different light from 6737's harsh noon, not a twin
quiet frame: yellow wall, white window, red window box, dark arched door, evening glow in the top windows. Never grouped or noted, just dropped
Hotel Pod Věží at night: lamp, flags, two diners under the umbrella, deep blue sky. The CCTV camera top left is a blemish; the 'busy terrace' in the cull note is calm at size
Čertovka, symmetric, no sign. Mihail: 7199 beats every portrait frame of this spot from any day; 7200 is fine to consider
Vrtba: diagonal down over the roof tiles and cone yews to the terrace, little sky. 7367 is half grey sky
the empty lane in sun, blue sky, deeper perspective; the AMBIX restaurant lettering is a blemish. 6831 has a white sky
tram 22 tighter and bigger, its red lights across the wet cobbles

Kampa square at dusk: three trunks divide the frame into panels under a canopy ceiling, the lit terrace a warm band behind against cool cobbles, benches repeating the rhythm. Costs: the woman in blue walking out of the right edge, the half bench along the bottom, the road signs. Passed over on the sheet for having no landmark; found by Mihail
the tram blurred closer, lit inside and red; more energy, hides more of the street
lamp in front, the red car, the castle over the plague column, more sky; busier than 6751
the bridge tower down Mostecká reflected in a black car's bonnet; the car fills the bottom. A clever idea, which this album has rated too high before
St Nicholas's flank, the triple lamp, the street to a dome: an establishing frame. Bin at the left corner
the oriel corner house on the square under cloud. Parked cars and strangers' faces bottom right

review.verdicts: 6760, 6955 and 7456 rejected; 7200 kept for consideration only; 6850 added; everything else agreed, including the held and stays-out calls
lessons: Critique stated facts (tiled floor, sun at the edge, two figures) instead of photographic reasons, so it can't compare frames and leaves minimal frames with nothing to say for them
Light was judged by category (blue hour, golden hour, night good; grey bad) instead of whether it suits the frame
Composition was judged too little: famous buildings that clip each other are a composition fault
